prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='THETA', seasonality_champion='NaiveSeasonal', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: y_true exhibits consistent downward trend across both validation folds. THETA and catboost both achieve perfect trend correlation (1.0), while NaiveSeasonal best captures seasonality (0.43 correlation). ONLY_FT_rf dominates overall RMSE (50.28), but early/late horizon specialists differ significantly (ONLY_FT_catboost: 29.75 vs catboost: 55.34). High model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio: 113.6) and concept drift detected suggest STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit decomposition structure while handling non-stationarity.
